prompt: Who will sign for the radios, and who will deliver them?
promptZh: 誰會簽領對講機？誰會把它們送去給引導人員？

options.text: Nia will sign; Leila will deliver.
options.whyZh: 兩人角色相反：蕾拉簽，妮雅送。

options.text: The clerk will sign; Nia will deliver.
options.zh: 庫房管理員簽領；妮雅送去。
options.whyZh: 妮雅送沒錯，但管理員不能自己簽領自己發出的物品。

options.text: Leila will sign and deliver the case herself.
options.zh: 蕾拉會簽領，也會親自送箱子。
options.whyZh: 蕾拉簽領後，由妮雅接手送箱子。

options.text: Leila will sign; Nia will deliver.
options.whyZh: 領班蕾拉先簽領，之後妮雅把箱子直接送給引導人員。

explanationZh: 領班蕾拉先簽領，之後妮雅把箱子直接送給引導人員。
evidence: I’m Nia from the event crew. Are the radios ready? I can carry them to the stewards if someone can sign for them here. / I’m the storeroom clerk. I can’t sign them out to myself. Could your crew leader come to the desk? I don’t want to leave a full case on the unattended side counter. / I’m Leila, the crew leader. I’ll sign before Nia takes the case. Can you leave one spare battery here? The late crew can pick it up from you. / That works. I’ll take the case straight to the stewards after you’ve signed.
